verdict.rationale: Bolt.new is an AI app-generation tool where the AI writes code from prompts (e.g., bolt-gh-2, bolt-docs-17), but there is no evidence of a feature that analyzes a user's own data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions about it (e.g., analytics-style recommendations). The Figma 'design system agent' (bolt-docs-20) and model auto-routing (bolt-docs-21) are generation/orchestration features, not data-insight generation. Missing for 10: any documented insight/suggestion feature that analyzes user data (database contents, app usage, etc.) and returns AI-driven recommendations.
